_comment: Real AUTO-role-detection prototype config for the final ESP32-H2 SuperMini graduation-project hardware (see docs/pogo-interface.md 'confirmed GPIO profile' and README's wiring section). This board's permanently-paired sensor is a Sensirion SGP40 (VOC only -- no NOx, see prototype_sgp41.json for VOC+NOx). dev_mode=AUTO: ROOT/INTERMEDIATE/LEAF is derived at runtime from real BASE_ID + DETECT_IN/OUT + PEER_HELLO, never forced. This file's upstream_port/downstream_port block is BYTE-FOR-BYTE identical to prototype_sht45.json's/prototype_bh1750.json's -- the only per-board differences across all four common-POGO-port prototypes are driver_id, i2c_address, sensor_type_bitmap, calibration and measurement_timeout_ms, exactly as section 2 of the follow-up spec requires. See tools/test_prototype_port_blocks_match.py, which mechanically checks this for all four.
_driver_comment: SENSOR_DRIVER_ID_SGP40 (see components/sensor_provider/include/sensor_provider/sensor_provider.h) and the VOC_RAW/VOC_INDEX channel bits (see components/sensor_channel/include/sensor_channel/sensor_channel.h) are resolved by name here -- tools/pack_module_config.py's DRIVER_IDS/CHANNEL_BITS tables mirror those two C headers bit-for-bit, so this file never repeats a magic number by hand. The two channel names listed here exactly match what components/sgp40/sgp40.c's sgp40_get_sensor_bitmap() actually reports at runtime (VOC_RAW + VOC_INDEX, no NOx channels -- SGP40 has no NOx sensing element at all).
_addr_comment: SGP40's 7-bit I2C address is fixed at 0x59 by the datasheet (not address-pin-selectable, unlike BH1750) -- see components/sgp40/sgp40.c's own header comment citing Sensirion's reference driver.
_calibration_comment: SGP40 has no calibration/offset fields of its own (the VOC Index Algorithm self-normalizes) -- calibration stays all-zero, same convention as every other driver when unused.
_timeout_comment: components/sgp40/sgp40.c hardcodes SGP40_MEASURE_MS_MAX=30ms (the measure-raw-signal command's own datasheet max) as the point read_measurement() actually stops waiting; measurement_timeout_ms is a SEPARATE, larger ceiling checked in the same polling loop purely to abandon a wedged/non-responding sensor (see sgp40_read_measurement()) -- it must stay comfortably above 30ms or a slow-but-healthy read would be misreported as SENSOR_STATUS_TIMEOUT before the real 30ms measurement window even elapses. 200ms (same value as prototype_sht45.json) leaves a wide margin for I2C bus contention/retries without ever being reached by a normal reading, and without stalling child_service's SENSOR_HELLO handler for long if the sensor really is unresponsive.
_polling_comment: Not a config field (the Gas Index Algorithm's minimum cadence is compiled into components/sgp40/sgp40.c's sgp40_get_min_polling_period_ms()==1000ms, enforced at runtime by sensor_service_compute_effective_period_ms() -- see tools/test_effective_polling_period.c) -- noted here only so this file's reader knows POLL_CONFIG's negotiated period can never go below 1 Hz for this driver regardless of what the parent's response-time-derived formula alone would pick.
_compensation_comment: IMPORTANT: components/sgp40/sgp40.c always compensates its raw VOC reading with a FIXED 50%RH/25degC default (SGP40_DEFAULT_RH_TICKS/SGP40_DEFAULT_T_TICKS) -- this board does NOT read another module's live SHT45 temperature/humidity over the wire (section 10 of the follow-up spec: never borrow another module's SHT45 reading and present it as real compensation). Do not mistake VOC_INDEX readings from this config for humidity/temperature-corrected values; they are only as accurate as that fixed assumption. The driver logs this loudly (ESP_LOGW) at every init specifically so this is never silently forgotten.
_upstream_comment: Identical to prototype_sht45.json's upstream_port -- see that file's _upstream_comment for why DETECT_IN is GPIO12/DETECT_OUT is GPIO2 (deep-sleep-ready profile, swapped from the earlier DETECT_IN=2/DETECT_OUT=12), and for the required rewiring before flashing.
